description: An explosive plyometric lunge switching legs in mid-air to build dynamic lower-body power and agility.
setup: Begin in a staggered lunge stance with both knees bent at roughly 90 degrees and torso tall.
steps: Lower into a lunge, loading weight through your front midfoot.
Drive explosively through both feet upward into the air.
Switch your front and back legs in mid-air.
Land softly on balls of feet and immediately absorb into the next lunge depth.
cues: Land softly like a cat by flexing your ankles and knees
Use your arms in opposition to aid vertical propulsion and balance

mistakes.mistake: Slamming the back knee into the ground on landing
mistakes.fix: Absorb landing smoothly and stop back knee one inch above the ground
Immediately cushion the landing by yielding into a deep lunge

rep_standard: Begins in lunge depth, leaves the floor with both feet simultaneously, switches stance in air, and lands softly into deep lunge.
